title: Intuitive communicators needed for a future event

tellings.quote: and so he told me that there would be some future event where the ability to intuitively communicate would help the military and help you know command and

plain: In the early 1990s at NSA headquarters in Maryland, an officer named Captain White is said to have told a young Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman that some "future event" was coming, and that the ability to communicate intuitively, mind to mind, would help the military and its command. Sherman tells Michels this as something White told him directly. He says he was trained for this, and he tells it because it would mean the government was preparing people to talk with non-human beings.
